name: UAE Freelancer & Small Business Bookkeeping Tracker 2026 — VAT Return + Corporate Tax Estimate (Excel / Google Sheets)
summary: Corporate Tax is due 30 September 2026. Log invoices and expenses once; your VAT 201 boxes, CT estimate, unpaid-invoice ageing and monthly dashboard fill themselves in.
description_html:
UAE Corporate Tax is due 30 September 2026. Log your invoices and expenses once and this fills in your VAT 201 boxes and your Corporate Tax estimate.

جدول إكسل لضريبة القيمة المضافة وضريبة الشركات في الإمارات — قالب جاهز للمستقلين والشركات الصغيرة. $24 ≈ AED 88, one-off. Charged in USD.

Built for UAE freelancers, consultants and small businesses who don't want to pay for accounting software yet — but need to get VAT and Corporate Tax right.

What it does

  • Income sheet — one row per invoice. Pick the VAT treatment (Standard 5% / Zero-rated / Exempt / Out of scope) and the VAT and total are calculated. Track paid / unpaid / partially paid and see days outstanding and an OVERDUE flag.
  • Expenses sheet — log receipts, mark whether input VAT is recoverable, and whether the cost is deductible for Corporate Tax.
  • VAT Return helper — set your FTA tax-period dates and the sheet totals standard-rated, zero-rated and exempt supplies, recoverable input VAT and net VAT payable/refundable — laid out like the return boxes so you can copy them into EmaraTax.
  • VAT registration check — rolling 12-month taxable turnover against the AED 375,000 mandatory and AED 187,500 voluntary thresholds.
  • Corporate Tax estimate — accrual revenue, deductible expenses, irrecoverable VAT, manual adjustments, the 0% band (AED 375,000), 9% rate and a Small Business Relief eligibility check (revenue ≤ AED 3M, periods ending on/before 31 Dec 2026). Shows a suggested monthly set-aside.
  • Dashboard — revenue, expenses, profit and cash by month; income and expense by category; receivables ageing; VAT due and CT estimate tiles.

Details

  • 500 rows per sheet, dropdowns everywhere, blue = type / black = formula, sample rows included.
  • All thresholds and rates live in one Settings sheet so you can update them if the law changes.
  • Works in Microsoft Excel (2016+) and Google Sheets (File → Import). No macros.
  • Instant download. Free updates to this 2026 edition.

Not sure whether you even have to file this year, or what being late costs? I wrote a free explainer on the 30 September 2026 Corporate Tax deadline — who must file, the Small Business Relief conditions (the window now runs to 2029), the AED 500/month penalty clock, and a six-step checklist. No email required. Read that first; buy this only if the bookkeeping is the part standing in your way.

Not tax advice. This is a bookkeeping aid; confirm obligations with the FTA (tax.gov.ae) or a registered tax agent.
